blocks.text: Nucleus ki banawat samajhne ke liye un forces ko janna zaroori hai jo nucleons ko jore rakhti hain. Is se pehle fitrat (nature) ki bunyadi forces janna chahiye. Kaainat (universe) bohat pecheeda lagti hai, phir bhi is ke tamam aapas ke asar (interactions) sirf chaar bunyadi forces se chalte hain, jinhein fundamental forces kehte hain. Yeh forces tay karti hain ke chhote atoms se le kar bari galaxies tak cheezein kaise harkat aur sulook karti hain. Chaar fundamental forces: gravity, electromagnetism, weak nuclear force aur strong nuclear force.

Gravitational force (gravity) chaaron mein sab se kamzor hai magar long-range (door tak asar karne wali) hai. Yeh hamesha kashish (attraction) ki force hai jo ajsaam (bodies) ke darmiyan hoti hai. Do ajsaam ke darmiyan gravity un ke masses ke hasil-e-zarb (product) ke proportional aur faasle ke murabba (square) ke ulat proportional hai. Suraj ya bare sayyaron (planets) jaise bhaari ajsaam ke liye yeh bohat aham hai kyunke un ke masses bare hain, magar atom ki satah par yeh itni kamzor hai ke nazar-andaz ki ja sakti hai.

Electromagnetic force electric aur magnetic fields ke asar ki zimmedar hai. Gravity ki tarah yeh bhi inverse square law (faasle ke murabbe ke ulat) par chalti hai, magar gravity se kahin zyada taqatwar hai. Atom ki banawat aur chemical bonding se le kar bijli, magnetism aur roshni ke phailao tak bohat si cheezein isi se chalti hain. James Clerk Maxwell (1861) ne chaar bunyadi equations banayin jinhon ne bijli aur magnetism ko mila kar electromagnetism bana diya. Yeh equations batati hain ke electric aur magnetic fields kaise asar karti hain aur electromagnetic waves kaise phailti hain, aur yeh ke electric aur magnetic forces alag nahi balke ek hi electromagnetic force ke do pehlu hain.

Chaar forces mein nuclear forces sab se taqatwar kashish wali forces hain. Electromagnetism maadde ko jore rakhta hai, magar yeh nahi batata ke nucleus kaise jura rehta hai. Agar sirf electromagnetism aur gravity hon to protons ki aapas ki dhakel (repulsion) se nucleus bikhar jaye. Nucleus ka qaim rehna batata hai ke andar koi aur force hai jo gravity aur electromagnetic force dono se taqatwar hai: yahi nuclear force hai. Strong nuclear force atoms ke nuclei ko jore rakhti hai. Yeh sirf nucleus ke andar hoti hai, is liye ise short-range (bohat kam faasle wali) force kehte hain. Yeh tamam nucleons (protons aur neutrons) ke darmiyan ek jaisi kashish ki force hai. Yani protons strong force se ek doosre ko khainchte hain aur saath hi electric force se dhakelte bhi hain. Neutron par charge nahi, phir bhi woh strong force se doosre neutrons ya protons ko khainchta hai. Weak nuclear force radioactive decay, khaas taur par beta decay, aur neutrinos wale asar ki zimmedar hai. Baqi forces ke ulat, weak force zarron ki pehchan (identity) badal sakti hai, maslan neutron ko proton bana deti hai; is liye sitaron mein nuclear fusion aur unstable nuclei ke decay ke liye zaroori hai. Chaaron forces ki nisbati (relative) taqat aur range Table 12.1 mein hai.

blocks.prompt: Strong nuclear force aur electric force mein kya mushabehat aur farq hai (short question 12.3)? Strong force nucleus ko kaise jore rakhti hai (short question 12.7)?
blocks.explanation: Dono bunyadi forces hain jo nucleus ke zarron par lagti hain, aur dono gravity se kahin taqatwar hain. Electric force sirf charges par lagti hai, khainch ya dhakel sakti hai, inverse-square se ghatti hai aur la-mehdood range rakhti hai; strong force taqreeban sau guna taqatwar, nucleons ke darmiyan hamesha kashish wali, protons aur neutrons par barabar, aur sirf taqreeban 10⁻¹⁵ m range wali hai. Nucleus ke andar padosi nucleons ki taqatwar kashish protons ke darmiyan electric dafa par ghalib aati hai, to nucleons jure rehte hain; neutrons dafa barhaye baghair kashish barhate hain.

items: Chaar fundamental forces: gravity (sab se kamzor, long-range, sirf kashish), electromagnetic (inverse square, gravity se kahin taqatwar; Maxwell 1861), strong (sab se taqatwar, short-range, tamam nucleons mein kashish, nucleus ko jore rakhti hai), weak (beta decay aur neutrinos; zarron ki pehchan badalti hai).
Table 12.1: strong 1 (< 10⁻¹⁵ m), electromagnetic 10⁻² (∞), weak 10⁻¹³ (< 10⁻¹⁸ m), gravity 10⁻³⁸ (∞).
